'''Scorched Books''' is a {{Mythic}} [[Power Stones|Power Stone]], which unlocks the {{PowerStoneLink|Scorching}} power for [[Accessories]], granting {{Stat|str}}, {{Stat|cd}}, and {{Stat|as}}. It also provides {{Stat|ferocity|+7}} as its unique power bonus.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Scorched Books''' is a {{O|r|no=yes}} drop from the {{Stier|2}} [[Inferno Demonlord]] or above if the player has {{Coll|Blaze Slayer LVL 2}}.

;Drop Chances
* {{Stier|2}}: {{Green|2.26%}} ({{Green|1/44.25}})
* {{Stier|3}}: {{Green|2.16%}} ({{Green|1/46.25}})
* {{Stier|4}}: {{Green|2.03%}} ({{Green|1/49.21}})

== Requirements ==
The '''Scorched Books''' requires {{Skill|combat|XXXV}} to be used and can only be used as a Power Stone for [[Accessories]]. Combining 9 '''Scorched Books''' at {{NPCSprite|Maxwell}} will permanently unlock the '''Scorching''' [[Power Stones|Power]] for [[Accessories]].

== Tips ==
* Due to granting a lot of {{stat|BAS}} as well as {{stat|str}} and {{stat|cd}}, it is recommended to use this power for anything melee, at least before unlocking {{Item|Golden Dragon Pet}}. 
** It is also the best [[Accessory Power]] for {{Stat|Ferocity}} making it useful against [[Enderman Slayer]], as well as [[Bosses]] which have a Damage cap.
* The Accessory Power granted by the {{Item|Furball}} can also be used to grant {{stat|BAS}}, since it's cheaper and {{Skl|Combat}} requirement is much lower, although the stats granted by it are worse.
* This item can be used even without {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 2}}.
